title: triadenum breviflorum
intro: Triadenum breviflorum, commonly known as Marsh Yellowcress or Marsh Cress, is a plant species in the family Podostemaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, potentially aiding in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, sore throats, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Yellowcress are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial effects. Bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
